notes: עַד אָנָה → How long: no matrix frame, so rule 17's duration-frame sentence does not apply; the two function morphemes cannot be allocated non-arbitrarily between How and long, so noncompositional with first-token fallback (rule 6) and target head on long stands.
תְּשִׂימוּ קִנְצֵי → hunt: 'set snares' rendered by one English verb; neither morpheme's own lexeme is written, so the fallback head s003 is correct. לְ → for is the rectum's relation (rule 19).
